hints.content:
To measure slope, we pick any two points on the line. Then we look at the horizontal and vertical distances between those points.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes each scale by one. A graph of a line intersects the points negative two, zero and negative three, negative three. There is a horizontal dotted segment from negative three, negative three to negative two, negative three that is labeled one. There is a vertical dotted segment from negative two, negative three to negative two, zero that is labeled three.

hints.content: The slope of the line is $3$.
